locations.label: Clipboard history files
locations.comment: Images and files you copied, stored as plain files named by content hash. Deleting removes clipboard history content; Raycast's Clear History cleans this too.

locations.label: Bundled Node runtime
locations.comment: Private Node.js runtime (~110 MB) shipped for extensions. Raycast reinstalls it automatically.

locations.label: File search index
locations.comment: Full-disk file index (minidex). Rebuilt automatically after removal.

locations.label: Extension API caches
locations.comment: Per-extension runtime caches. Extension code itself is stored inside Raycast's encrypted database.

locations.label: Raycast data root
locations.comment: Settings, snippet and history databases (encrypted). Kept intact; only the itemized subfolders above are called out.

locations.label: Automatic database backups
locations.comment: Daily full copies of Raycast's databases under per-version folders. Older timestamped folders can go.

locations.label: Sandbox VM images
locations.comment: Linux VM images used for sandboxed code execution (multiple GB, sparse). Re-downloaded on next use.

locations.label: VM bundle cache
locations.comment: Cached VM bundles for code mode. Re-created when needed.

locations.label: Bundled CLI versions
locations.comment: claude-code bundles kept by the updater, one folder per version.

locations.label: Claude data root
locations.comment: App settings and local stores (includes the bundled Chromium copy). Chat data is synced via your account.

locations.label: Cherry Studio data
locations.comment: App data including knowledge bases, model provider caches and bundled toolchains.

locations.label: Workspace state
locations.comment: Per-workspace caches and state. VS Code rebuilds what it needs.

locations.label: VS Code user data
locations.comment: Settings, state and caches in one folder; the itemized subfolders above are the regenerable parts.

locations.label: Installed extensions
locations.comment: Downloaded extension payloads. Deleting an extension folder uninstalls that extension.

locations.label: Cursor user data
locations.comment: Settings, chat history and caches in one folder.

locations.label: Installed extensions
locations.comment: Extension payloads; some ship platform binaries for every OS (hundreds of MB of dead weight possible).

locations.label: Session transcripts
locations.comment: Per-project conversation transcripts. Can reach many GB; this is your history — back up before deleting.

locations.label: Claude Code data root
locations.comment: Config plus the itemized subfolders. Watch for stray .bk backup folders.

locations.label: Chat session logs
locations.comment: One JSONL per conversation. Months of sessions can reach tens of GB — your conversation history; back up first.

locations.label: Archived sessions
locations.comment: Rotated older sessions; same nature as sessions/.

locations.label: Historical CLI releases
locations.comment: Every release the updater ever kept (~250 MB each). Only the current one is used.

locations.label: Agent worktrees
locations.comment: Git worktrees created by agent runs. May contain uncommitted work — review before deleting.

locations.label: Codex data root
locations.comment: Config, auth and history databases; the itemized subfolders above are the big movers.

locations.label: ZCode data
locations.comment: Assistant sessions, caches and settings.

locations.label: OpenCode data
locations.comment: Config, session data and caches.

locations.label: Model weights
locations.comment: Downloaded model weights. Removing a model forces a full re-pull later.

locations.label: Package download cache
locations.comment: Safe to clear (npm cache clean --force); contents re-download on demand.

locations.label: pnpm store and global bin
locations.comment: Content-addressable package store. Old-generation stores can be reclaimed with pnpm store prune.

locations.label: ~/.cache
locations.comment: Shared cache dir used by pip, puppeteer and other tools; each recreates its own subfolder.
